summary: A resort lookout tower at Port Carling, Muskoka, not a government fire tower; sources disagree on steel or wood and it is best known from the Red Green Show.

facts.status_note: A 2009 Ominous post says the wooden tower still stands; the undated GeoCities still-standing list also includes it. Its current condition is not documented.

access.note: A comment on the Ominous page says the tower is on private land. Sources place it on the grounds of the old Ferndale Resort. No source describes public access.

notes_for_editor: Ferndale is a resort-built lookout, not a government fire tower. The GeoCities oldtowers page and the Ominous page both say so and both place it at the Ferndale Resort. The date is vague: GeoCities says the 1960s, Ominous says the middle of the 20th century, so no build year is recorded in events. Material is disputed and left open: firelookout.ca says steel (citing a 1996 Huntsville topographic map), Ominous says wooden. Status 'standing' rests on a 2009 Ominous post and an undated still-standing list; the Ominous comment that the tower may have been rebuilt is a user comment and is reported as such, not as fact. The access level 'private' rests on one user comment and is low confidence. The 'Ranger Gord' material on GeoCities and Ominous describes a fictional TV character and is not used as evidence of fire watch. The YouTube 'Abandoned Muskoka' item and Ominous comments tie the resort site to Lake Rosseau and a 1946 fire; not used because it is unsourced for this tower. The brief's kind 'tower' and elevation 270 m match firelookout.ca. No corrections proposed beyond status, which is now standing per sources.
